# MDL202 · `group-name-case`

<!-- Generated by tools/gendocs from internal/rules: do not edit. -->

A group name matches a known group only when case is ignored.

| | |
|---|---|
| Family | groups |
| Default severity | error |
| Fix | unsafe |
| Design references | F5, case 34 |

## Why

mydumper looks groups up with `g_key_file_has_group`, which is case-sensitive: [MyDumper] is never read, and every option in it is silently lost. [client] is not reported: the MySQL client library reads it whatever the case.

## Example

❌ Before:

```ini
[MyDumper]
threads=4
[Myloader_Session_Variables]
sql_mode=x
[CLIENT]
user=u
```

```text
1:2-1:10 error MDL202[group-name-case] [MyDumper] is not [mydumper]: group names are case-sensitive
  = mydumper never reads this group: every key in it is ignored.
  fix (unsafe): Rename the group to [mydumper]
3:2-3:28 error MDL202[group-name-case] [Myloader_Session_Variables] is not [myloader_session_variables]: group names are case-sensitive
  = myloader never reads this group: every key in it is ignored.
  fix (unsafe): Rename the group to [myloader_session_variables]
```

✅ After `mydumper-lint check --fix --unsafe-fixes`:

```ini
[mydumper]
threads=4
[myloader_session_variables]
sql_mode=x
[CLIENT]
user=u
```

## Configuration

Enabled by default. To change its severity or turn it off:

```yaml
rules:
  severity:
    MDL202: warning   # or error, info, off
```

To accept one occurrence, put `# mydumper-lint: disable-next-line=MDL202` on the line above it.
